speaker: ASTER LAB · YOUR FIRST DAY
title: The new assistant
text: Your first shift. A visitor badge, a desk you have not found yet, and a machine nobody can quite explain. Dr Vale is waiting beside the test platform.

speaker: DR VALE · LAB TECHNICIAN
title: Ten seconds. Then sixty.
text: Our device seems to reach another dimension. Working theory, of course. I went through for ten seconds. Breathable air. Solid ground. So we tried one minute.

speaker: DR VALE · LAB TECHNICIAN
title: A very strange welcome
text: A whole island! Some fellow at the gate kept saying I needed training. A tutorial, he called it. Then a woman offered me a sword. Can you imagine—

speaker: DR VALE · LAB TECHNICIAN
title: Take it. Hide.
text: That was the security door. Take the device. Hide behind the storage cabinets. Whoever they are, they must not get it. If this works out, come out when it is safe.

speaker: BEYOND THE CABINET
title: The wrong visitors
text: Boots on broken glass. “Where is the traveller?” Vale says nothing. A second voice: “Find the key. Seal this side.” Then footsteps, moving closer.

speaker: YOU · UNDER YOUR BREATH
title: One way out
text: They are still coming. Vale said ten seconds was safe. Please let this thing work.

speaker: YOU · AN IMPOSSIBLE SHORE
title: Beyond the glass
text: Salt air. No alarms. The device has folded itself into a warm stone. I need a way back. And someone who can explain this place.

speaker: EDDA · KEEPER OF THE LIGHT
title: A new arrival
text: Another traveller? The Creator always sends you here first. Gather two driftwood and two copper ore. We will get you ready for the mainland.

speaker: YOU · A PRIVATE THOUGHT
title: A name everyone knows
text: The Creator? She says it like I should know. Did the lab discover this place… or did someone build it?

speaker: EDDA · KEEPER OF THE LIGHT
title: Fire and copper
text: That will do. Use the old forge to make a sword and dagger. There are patterns on the anvil.

speaker: EDDA · KEEPER OF THE LIGHT
title: Two ways to fight
text: The sword sweeps. The dagger strikes quickly. Land three hits with each on the effigy, then visit the rune well.

speaker: EDDA · KEEPER OF THE LIGHT
title: A little borrowed fire
text: Your stone holds an ember. Shape it into a bolt. Try three casts on the effigy. Focus returns between spells.

speaker: EDDA · KEEPER OF THE LIGHT
title: The garden has changed
text: Three shades are loose in the garden. This is not part of the training. Dodge their red circles. Fish and cook at my fire if you need food.

speaker: EDDA · KEEPER OF THE LIGHT
title: The last watch
text: The Hollow Warden guards the crossing. Free him from the shadow. Keep clear when his circle fills.

speaker: THE HOLLOW WARDEN
title: The way onward
text: The beacon is a door. Bring it the embers. And traveller… someone has been opening doors from the other side.

speaker: EDDA · KEEPER OF THE LIGHT
title: Beyond the first shore
text: Lantern Reach is through the light. Find Mara at the ward station. And keep your stone close. The Creator never gave us one like that.

speaker: YOU · LANTERN REACH
title: A world beyond the lesson
text: Houses. Roads. People who live here. This is more than a training ground. Maybe someone in town knows how to get home.

speaker: MARA · WARDKEEPER
title: A light for the living
text: You came through Edda’s gate? Good. Our three ward lamps failed when the sky shook. Each needs one wood and one copper. Repair them before more shadows get in.

speaker: MARA · WARDKEEPER
title: The town can breathe
text: The lamps are holding. Take these blade fittings, and some food. Neri went to the old archive before the failure. Two sentinels have her trapped. Bring her home.

speaker: NERI · ARCHIVIST
title: Someone changed the orders
text: Those sentinels were built to protect us. Today they demanded a traveller’s key. The observatory ledger might explain why. Its custodian will not let me near it.

speaker: THE OBSERVATORY LEDGER
title: An impossible entry
text: Beneath a century of weathered entries, a fresh line glows: ASTER LAB / RETURN TEST / 00:61. Destination authorised by the Founder. Beneath it: RETURN CHANNEL SUSPENDED.

speaker: YOU · A PRIVATE THOUGHT
title: Sixty-one seconds
text: Vale said one minute. This record knows our lab. And it calls the Creator “Founder.” I should show Neri before I touch anything else.

speaker: NERI · ARCHIVIST
title: A missing beginning
text: Our oldest books begin with the Creator’s arrival. Nothing before. Aster is not a word in our language. If your lab made the key, who wrote its name here?

speaker: A VOICE THROUGH THE DEVICE
title: Still on the other side
text: Assistant? If you can hear me, do not try the return setting. They are listening. Find the second anchor. I left a—

speaker: YOU · A PRIVATE THOUGHT
title: The second anchor
text: Vale is alive. Somewhere. The device has saved a broken set of coordinates. First I need to learn who built the anchors, and who is listening.

speaker: EDDA · KEEPER OF THE LIGHT
title: A familiar shore
text: The crossing is open both ways now. Rest by the fire whenever you need. Mara will be waiting in Lantern Reach.

speaker: MARA · WARDKEEPER
title: The lamps are holding
text: A quiet street is a fine reward. Neri is at the archive. If anyone can make sense of your stone, she can.

speaker: NERI · ARCHIVIST
title: Work still to do
text: I will keep looking for the second anchor. Your journal has everything we know. For now, the road beyond the observatory is sealed.
